purpose: Replace the closed fixed-proposal IID importance architecture with a prospective controlled-weight SMC estimator of the 256-parent aggregate geometry evidence.

source_failure.interpretation: The sealed g_A IID importance architecture failed its prospective geometry-support gate; this is not evidence of physical tension or parent preference.

target.midpoint_state: q in R^3, unbounded and not wrapped
target.axis_state: unoriented axis [a] in RP2 represented by one canonical unit vector
target.terminal_normalizer: I_bar = integral pi0(q,a) Z_bar(q,a) dq da

piecewise_geometry.rounding: IEEE-754 NumPy rint, nearest integer with exact half ties to even

canonical_vector_rule.sign: if the selected coordinate is negative multiply the full vector by -1
canonical_vector_rule.zero_vector: fatal; mathematically impossible for a unit axis here

piecewise_geometry.canonical_axis_state: normalize a, then apply canonical_vector_rule to a
piecewise_geometry.canonical_axis_offset: apply canonical_vector_rule independently to raw o
piecewise_geometry.point_construction: centres m-o and m+o; six fixed Cartesian shell probes of radius 2 cells around each centre
piecewise_geometry.antipodal_contract: a and -a may permute centres but must give identical normalized log_Z
piecewise_geometry.periodicity: only point and grid indices are modulo 576; q itself remains unbounded

initialization.midpoint: independent draw from the unchanged diagonal Gaussian p(q)
initialization.axis: draw z=2U-1 and phi=2*pi*V on S2, then canonicalize to RP2

adaptive_tempering.endpoint_rule: if CESS(1-beta) >= 1638.4, set next beta exactly to 1

bisection.update: feasible midpoint replaces low; infeasible midpoint replaces high

adaptive_tempering.temperature_stagnation: fatal if remaining beta exceeds 1e-10 but selected increment is <=1e-12

resampling.trigger: strictly ESS < 1024.0; equality does not resample
resampling.CDF_tie_rule: select lowest index whose cumulative weight is >= threshold
resampling.ancestor_labels: offspring inherit the selected particle's initial ancestor label
resampling.event_counter: starts at zero and increments only when resampling occurs

MH_rejuvenation.schedule: after every positive beta update and optional resampling, execute exactly four complete sweeps at the new beta

axis_local.kernel: antipodal_vMF centred on current unoriented axis
axis_local.density: kappa*cosh(kappa*a_dot_b)/(4*pi*sinh(kappa)) on S2, followed by canonical RP2 folding
axis_local.sampling: choose sign plus or minus with probability 1/2, sample vMF(sign*a,kappa), normalize and canonicalize

MH_rejuvenation.joint_local: draw q scale and axis kappa independently from the frozen scale distributions and propose both
MH_rejuvenation.prior_independence: draw q prime from p(q) and a prime from Uniform(RP2)
MH_rejuvenation.nonfinite_oracle_value: fatal numerical failure, never a silent rejection

genealogy.terminal_descendant_fraction: g_r = number of terminal particles descended from initial particle r divided by 2048

cache_values: log_Z_j for all 256 parents as float64
oracle_and_cache.new_keys_within_one_oracle_call: deduplicate and sort lexicographically before evaluation
oracle_and_cache.cache_collision_rule: same key must reproduce bitwise-identical log_Z; otherwise fatal

parent_response_atlas.purpose: avoid one N576 inverse FFT per parent at every SMC sweep without approximating the target
parent_response_atlas.construction: one exact fine inverse FFT per parent, then extract a local point-response cube as float64
parent_response_atlas.midpoint_core_domain: all midpoint cells whose q rounding bins intersect prior_mean plus or minus 10 prior_sigma independently in each coordinate
parent_response_atlas.padding_reason: maximum centre offset 3 plus shell radius 2
parent_response_atlas.outside_atlas_policy: evaluate by the exact full-response slow path for all outside keys in that batch; never reject, clip or approximate

oracle_and_cache.regression_cache_namespace: separate and forbidden as a production cache input

terminal_parent_reconstruction.bounds: 0 <= c_ij <= 1 and sum_j c_ij = 1 for every terminal particle
terminal_parent_reconstruction.future_joint_sampler: choose replicate proportional to exp(log_I_bar_r), choose terminal particle by W_ri, then choose parent by c_rij

geometry_key_tests: positive and negative exact half-cell ties use ties-to-even
axis-component max-absolute ties use lowest coordinate index
a and -a produce the same canonical cache key
a and -a normalized log_Z difference at most 1e-12
validation.phase_27_tests: compare covariance, Cholesky, logdet and log_Z to the existing dense phase-control reference
SMC_unit_tests: conditional ESS root and endpoint rule
normalizer accumulation with and without resampling
local and independence MH detailed balance
controller API cannot receive parent-specific or CF4 fields

prospective_gates.reason_old_gate_not_reused: SMC has a distinct controlled-weight and replicate-stability contract; this is a new estimator, not a retrospective relaxation.

failure_actions.invalid_lineage_or_numerics: No scientific conclusion. Repair only the invalid implementation and rerun the identical frozen program.
failure_actions.SMC_temperature_genealogy_or_replicate_i: Stop this architecture. No automatic particle increase, extra replicate, kernel retuning, or seed extension.
failure_actions.stable_SMC_but_parent_support_or_CF4_fai: Report physical tension. Do not alter peak targets, sigma, or CF4 gates after reading results.
failure_actions.all_gates_pass: Authorize only the design of a separate joint parent-geometry conditional-field bank.

artifacts.response_atlas_storage: one immutable float64 NPY shard per parent plus a canonical JSON manifest
artifacts.evidence_cache_storage: append-only immutable NPY or NPZ shards containing keys and log_Z[unique_key,256], each with SHA256
replicate_storage: move proposal and acceptance counts by scale
artifacts.JSON_policy: summaries, lineage, gates, and decisions only; no per-particle or per-cache-cell dictionaries
